Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years, every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Regular surveillance for breast cancer recurrence, including evaluation with a cancer-related history and physical examination, is essential for early detection of recurrence.
Women who have had lumpectomies should have annual mammography of both breasts to monitor for recurrence or new primary breast cancer.
Postmenopausal women should have a baseline DEXA scan to assess bone health and repeat every 2 years, especially if on aromatase inhibitors or with chemotherapy-induced menopause.
